value.notes: Review-only proposal outside published 1.3.0. Website permission is unresolved: developer page encourages integration but FAQ prohibits direct audio links from third-party websites. directListening.notes: GitHub Pages: FAQ prohibits direct audio-stream linking from third-party websites, conflicting with the broad developer-page invitation. Seek written clarification before Web integration. Android: FAQ conditionally permits multi-station apps without J1 branding or stream-interrupting monetization; validate the final app separately. Shared catalogue rights are unconfirmed pending platform-specific review.

value.title: J1 Radio official app developer permission and HTTPS streams
value.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-06. Explicitly encourages listed J1 HITS/XTRA/GOLD streams in third-party apps/websites. No J1 HD; no in-stream ads or ads that interrupt playback; RadioBee must not impersonate J1. Direct user-initiated listening only; no RadioBee relay/recording. Technical verification remains separate.

value.title: J1 Radio official history and legal origin
value.notes: Official legal section states all J1 streams originate from Canada through Torontocast. No city inferred. Japanese-music services, not local Indian broadcasts.

value.title: J1 FAQ: mobile apps versus website audio linking
value.notes: FAQ permits conditional mobile integration but prohibits directly linking audio streams from websites. Read together with the developer page; Web publication requires clarification. Official J1 homepage is the listener-facing link.
